title: Hot-day behavior change, Philadelphia
description: Real: Google Community Mobility Reports for Philadelphia County, summer weekdays 2020–2022, hot days (PHL Tmax ≥ 92°F, n=44) vs typical days (78–88°F, n=94), compared within the same month. Simulated: the same residents on a moderate heatwave vs a normal summer day.
error_label: Mean absolute error: 2.0 percentage points across 6 activity categories

calibration.version: v1 · aware residents always cancel outdoor plans
v2 · current rules (cancel / shift / go anyway)

notes: Caveats: mobility data are from the COVID era (2020–22) and measure visits relative to a Jan–Feb 2020 baseline; the simulation measures resident-hours. The sim still over-predicts how much people avoid parks. Next step: ATUS diaries × NOAA for time-use validation.
